Carlos / team — thanks for the diagram, it's helpful. A few quick notes after a rapid pass:
- VPC peering path looks standard; we’ll recommend a dedicated peering connection for control-plane traffic and a separate private endpoint for data egress to avoid noisy-neighbor issues.
- We'll need the CIDR ranges you plan to use for both the control and data paths (please confirm).
- For the on-prem appliance option we need:
  * Rack space: 2U minimum (3U preferred)
  * NICs: 2 x 25GbE for data + 1 x 1Gb for management (redundant power if available)
  * OS image requirements: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS base or equivalent

I'll bring a first-draft firewall/port matrix to the preflight. Naomi / Monica — I'll upload the network checklist and an initial rollout plan to the shared Drive before the call (link below).

– Markus
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@artemisbio.com>

Naomi / Markus — Thu 10/7 09:00 PT works for us.

CIDR ranges are below:
- Control plane: 10.10.0.0/20
- Data plane: 172.31.0.0/20

A couple clarifications:
- For the on-prem NICs, we can provision 2 x 25GbE and redundant power.
- We do not have an existing VPN appliance — preferred to use direct peering + private endpoints.

See you Thursday.

Carlos

- Host requirements: 2U, 2x25GbE, Ubuntu 22.04 base, NVMe for model cache (>= 2TB).
